encoding_rules.float14-nearest: truncate(f32(f32(16383 * host_float) + 0.5)); send 7-bit MSB then LSB
encoding_rules.float14-truncate: truncate(f32(16383 * host_float)); clip 0..16383 and split MSB then LSB
encoding_rules.integer: int selector value, tone clips to 0..127
encoding_rules.variax-wrapped: SysEx body [16, 0, controller, value] with header/model/terminator requested. Tone stores the integer.
encoding_rules.model-index: first matching model ID ordinal, or zero if absent

model_defaults.initial_patch: L6PODxtDevice loads its bundled default tone at construction. Model selection offline changes the existing model ID and keeps its parameters.

host_companions.connected: Amp, Stomp, Mod, Delay, Reverb and Wah request edit-buffer merge. Cab refreshes mic and room UI. Pack-unavailable Amp/Cab/Stomp/Mod/Delay choices fall back to the model IDs below.

firmware_companions.reason: The encoder sends the selector only. Companion values after selection are supplied by the device edit-buffer response.

tweak_targets.notes: Layout knob indexes are zero based. -1 and positions without a definition are omitted from the menu. Delay layout falls back to its only editor entry.

PERCENT.conversion: Normalize and clip to 0..1, round to nearest 7-bit step, then round 100 * step / 127 to nearest integer. Step 40 displays 32%.

MODSPEED.conversion: linear from normalized float with clipping

XOVER.conversion: Nearest 7-bit step. Interpolate between nodes spaced 16 steps apart, with the last node used at step 127.
